segments.title: This animal SURVIVED open space
segments.say: This tiny animal survived open space. It's called the water bear, or tardigrade.

segments.title: Up to 1.5 mm long
segments.say: It's tiny, up to about one and a half millimeters long.

segments.title: Sent into orbit in 2007
segments.say: In two thousand seven, scientists sent them into orbit on a European space mission.

segments.title: Vacuum? Cosmic rays? Fine.
segments.say: Most survived the vacuum of space. Most survived cosmic rays too.

segments.title: Some beat 1,000x the UV
segments.say: Some even survived sun UV over a thousand times stronger than on Earth. And still had babies after.

segments.sub: to the friend who'd survive anything
segments.say: Send this to the friend who'd survive anything.
